# API Reference — `parser`

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Document | API Reference |
| Component | `parser` |
| Owning Team | Arithmetic Excellence Center (AEC) |
| Classification | INTERNAL |
| Service Version | 0.1.0 |

## 1. HTTP (port 8080)

| Method | Path | Description | Response |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/health` | Liveness and readiness | `200 { "status": "ok", "checks": { ... } }`, `503` when a check fails |
| `GET` | `/metrics` | Prometheus metrics | `200 text/plain; version=0.0.4` |

Errors use RFC 9457 (`application/problem+json`).

Any other path answers `404` and any other method on these paths `405`, both
as problem details. The gateway has no route to the parser.

## 2. gRPC

None: the parser has no gRPC interface and opens no port 9090.

## 3. Events

The parser consumes with the consumer group `parser` and is idempotent by
`eventId` (`processed_events`). A consumed event yields exactly one of:
a produced `aaas.addition.requested.v1` (same `taskId`, trace continued), a
stored rejection (nothing produced), or, for a message that is not such an
event, a discarded message (nothing produced or stored).

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: events (scripts/service-api.py, do not edit) -->
### `aaas.addition.requested.v1` (produced)

A parsed addition of a and b; from P2.17 validated, with b the smaller operand.

- Producer: `parser`; partitions: 3; message key: `taskId`.
- Schema: [`aaas.addition.requested.v1.schema.json`](../../../contracts/events/aaas.addition.requested.v1.schema.json) (`urn:aaas:events:aaas.addition.requested.v1`), in the envelope of `CLAUDE.md` 4.2.

| Payload field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `a` | yes | First operand, the augend. |
| `b` | yes | Second operand, the addend: the number of successor calls. |

### `aaas.expression.submitted.v1` (consumed)

An expression completed by "=" and accepted as a new task.

- Producer: `expression-assembler`; partitions: 3; message key: `taskId`.
- Schema: [`aaas.expression.submitted.v1.schema.json`](../../../contracts/events/aaas.expression.submitted.v1.schema.json) (`urn:aaas:events:aaas.expression.submitted.v1`), in the envelope of `CLAUDE.md` 4.2.

| Payload field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | yes | Identifier of the calculator session generated by the frontend (lowercase UUID of any version), as sent in the body of POST /api/v1/keys. |
| `expression` | yes | Digit and `+` keys of the session in order, typed after the last `C` or `=` (or since the session started) and before the submitting `=`, which is not included. The syntax (exactly one `+` between two numbers) is checked by parser and the range by validator, so a malformed expression is still a valid event. |
